description: Fontaines à eau dans le réseau RATP is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RATP. Ce jeu de données contient la liste des fontaines à eau potable mises à disposition au public depuis le réseau RATP, l'adresse, la localisation en zone de contrôlée ou pas. La localisation des fontaines à eau est approximative. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Fontaines, Eau potable. The portal shows 115 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
